qualification:
Same-allocation native/full-reference decoder-prefix join, frame separated.
The native byte frame is certified by independent allocation/index cases, not
assumed by this harness or re-instrumented across the second execution. These
checks alone give no initial-buffer preservation or whole-stage equivalence.
domain: All proof58295/public1880/checkpoint1768 bytes in original owned allocations, all account metadata, every signed borrow flag, every nonzero usize Rc header, independent arbitrary data/lamport aliases and instruction/account lengths0..3. Native prefix frame forbids all byte/descriptor/metadata writes; only three borrow-counter cells and the decoder-hit array are permitted. After native SDK owners drop, the complete borrowed reference consumes those same original buffers without snapshots. Native decoder entry implies identical reference entry/error and scalar heap restoration.
remaining: Every all-root/index-window native frame certificate must be linked at identical native source/SDK/harness domain, plus checked index coverage, before initial-heap identification. Native decoder error prefix and model scan=false/reached-native pure scan abstraction only. Actual success continuations, child/runtime/oracle/state joins remain. No native frame assumed by a contract; this is an ordinary proof harness with no SDK method stubs.
unreachable_cuts: Both native/owned first_decoded and actual validator/encoder receive assert-false panic cuts, not successful replies. Every cut reachability/safety assertion must pass. This removes statically retained verifier/arithmetic bodies from frame instrumentation; it does not assume their unreachability.
input_constructor: Pinned Kani library vec::exact_vec<u8,N>: Box::new(any<[u8;N]>()) followed by boxed-slice into_vec; every input byte remains independently arbitrary. No buffer byte is fixed, left uninitialized, or assumed. Native source, model, assertions and enforced write set are unchanged.
error_assertions: Constructor-complete matches replace derived ProgramError/Result PartialEq/Debug assertions in the proof harness only. Both results must be exactly Err(InvalidAccountData), preserving full status equality at this decoder-error cut; no payload/error/state premise is removed. Frozen SDK/caller and complete reference bodies, input domains and enforced native frame are unchanged.
